title: Netlife fleet manifest
description: Per-site manifest at .netlife/fleet.json. Every key is optional; scripts/manifest.sh applies the defaults.

slug.description: Short site identifier used in snapshot keys and preview names. Default: the repository name after the slash, lowercased, characters outside a-z0-9 removed, cut to 12 characters. Set it explicitly when that result is not a valid slug.

snapshot.description: Where the database snapshot for verify and previews comes from.

source.description: Snapshot source. production: the site's production database. staging: for sites without a production environment. none: no snapshot. forge-backup: Craft's own backup via Forge.

key.description: Object key of the snapshot in storage. Default: snapshots/<slug>/latest.sql.gz.

crawlLimit.description: Maximum number of pages the crawler visits.

ignoreLogPattern.description: Regular expression for log lines that are not treated as errors. Empty means nothing is ignored.

environment.description: GitHub environment that holds the verify secrets.

develop.description: The integration branch that follows main. Absent: detected on origin (develop is used when it exists). A string names the branch without probing. null means the site has no such branch.

preview.description: Preview environment settings. Owned by craft-preview; the resolver only checks that this is an object.

phpVersion.description: PHP version for the preview site. No default: it must be set when previews are used.

webDirectory.description: Web root relative to the repository root.

buildCommand.description: Command that builds front-end assets before deploy.

siteUrls.description: Craft site URL environment variables to point at the preview domain.

env.description: Extra environment variables for the preview site.

domain.description: on-forge: use a Forge-provided domain. custom: use the site's own preview domain.

language.description: Craft site language for the preview.

maxAgeDays.description: Previews older than this many days are cleaned up.
